notes: Official FAQ (https://www.goldcoastairport.com.au/contact-us/contact-us/faqs, read directly 18 Oct 2026): "Are there Multi-Faith areas at the airport? Yes, three Multi-Faith/Prayer Rooms are available: Near the main security point, opposite the domestic passenger screening area. In the Domestic Departures Lounge, near Hungry Jack’s. In the International Departures Lounge on Level 2, near WHSmith." The official Hidden Disabilities page (https://www.goldcoastairport.com.au/accessibility/accessibility-overview/hidden-disabilities) says: "There are three multi faith rooms in the terminal. One is in the landside concourse area directly opposite the main screening point. The second is in the international departures lounge on Level 02. Both rooms are also accessible for those with hidden disabilities requiring a quiet space. The third is located at the domestic departures, northern amenity block near Gate 05." The two pages describe the domestic room's landmark differently; both are recorded. Side for the departures-lounge rooms inferred from 'Departures Lounge' (after screening). No hours, wudu or women's-space details published. The site's /search?q= URL returned 404, but the FAQ and accessibility pages list the rooms directly. Not visually verified.
